Class TaDatabase

java.lang.Object
com.bupt.ta.persistence.TaDatabase
@Deprecated public final class TaDatabase extends Object
Deprecated.
Call servlet-context bootstrap instead.
Narrow delegation layer over TaDatabase.

New code should depend directly on com.bupt.ta.db.facade types; this class exists solely to avoid breaking stale imports inside legacy modules.
